entries.a: Zenovix covers six areas end to end: 1) Artificial Intelligence, 2) Cloud & ICT, 3) Web & Mobile, 4) Intelligent Automation, 5) Data & Analytics, 6) Animation & 3D. One partner for strategy, design, engineering and the AI that ties it together. Which one can I tell you more about?

Our Artificial Intelligence practice ships custom models, computer vision and conversational AI trained on your data and deployed production-ready — assistants and chatbots on your own knowledge, document understanding, and forecasting models that are deployed and monitored.

Cloud & ICT at Zenovix: secure infrastructure, networks and systems integration engineered for scale — cloud architecture and migration, DevOps with CI/CD and observability, identity, security hardening and backup.

Yes — we build fast, beautiful websites and apps, bilingual EN/AR ready with full RTL support: corporate sites, landing pages, e-commerce, iOS and Android apps, plus motion and performance work that converts.

Our Intelligent Automation team builds AI agents and workflow automation on WhatsApp, Telegram, e-mail and the web — with human-in-the-loop approvals for anything sensitive, and CRM / ERP / messaging integrations so your team focuses on judgement, not friction.
Data & Analytics: dashboards and pipelines that turn raw numbers into decisions — data warehousing and ETL, BI dashboards and KPI reporting, plus data quality and governance.
Animation & 3D: brand films and explainer animation, AI-generated video and motion graphics, and 3D product visualisation including interactive web 3D — the story your technology deserves.

Starting is simple: send us a short brief through the contact form on zenovix.ae, e-mail studio@zenovix.com or WhatsApp +971 4570 1100. We understand the business first, then come back with a proposal — strategy before a single line of code.

You can reach the studio at studio@zenovix.com, +971 4570 1100, or WhatsApp https://wa.me/97145701100 — we answer 09:00-18:00 Gulf Standard Time. Proposals and anything sensitive always go to a human manager.
Our office is at Office 2703, Aspect Tower, Business Bay, Dubai, UAE. We're engineered in Dubai and delivered worldwide.

Zenovix is a Dubai studio for the digital frontier — a team of engineers, designers and AI specialists building the systems modern businesses run on. We work like a partner, not a vendor: strategy first, craft in the details, built to last.

Every project is scoped individually, so there are no public price lists. Tell us the shape of the project and we'll prepare a written proposal with a clear quote — usually after one short discovery call.
We work 09:00-18:00 Gulf Standard Time. The bot answers instantly; anything that needs a manager (quotes, contracts) is handed over and answered within business hours.
